hypotheses.name: robust_ball_motion
hypotheses.change: Add seven bounded ball spread, observation support and robust displacement features to the selected 46 inputs.
hypotheses.prediction: Visible-ball stoppage recall improves without adding false D fragments.

hypotheses.name: slot_invariant_motion
hypotheses.change: Replace four slot-differenced relative velocity inputs with same-team position-set matches at 0.2 seconds.
hypotheses.prediction: Identity-switch artifacts fall and unsupported possession fragments decrease.

hypotheses.name: penalty25
hypotheses.change: Retain the selected probabilities and smoothing; increase the single switch cost from 3 to 25 (one second of correlated evidence). No minimum duration.
hypotheses.prediction: Weak extra possessions disappear while strongly supported short changes survive.

protocols.buffered_minutes: Original five held-out minutes; 250-frame training buffers.
protocols.purged_spells: Same held-out minutes and buffers; additionally exclude every complete true H/A/D run intersecting that validation minute. Validation labels define exclusions only and never enter model inputs, fitting weights or decoding.

fixed: Two equal-objective shallow XGBoost models; unchanged seed, symmetry augmentation, continuity prior and 51-frame centered probability smoothing. Three alternatives, no sweep or combined candidate.
interpretation: A screening rule for this adaptive development round, not statistical proof. All public labels were previously inspected. No untouched evaluation set or private full-match labels are available.
